definitions.canonical_expression: A(h(x,y))={p(x,y) if y<=2} union {p(x,y-1) if y>=1}; A(v(x,y))={p(x,y) if x<=2} union {p(x-1,y) if x>=1}
B_p -> tau_z(p); X_l -> product_{p in A(l)} tau_x(p)
G(x,y)=product_{links l incident on vertex (x,y)} X_l; G(x,y)=I in the reduced physical representation
Theta=K in the real Pauli basis
For s in D4, U_s tau_alpha(p) U_s^(-1)=tau_alpha(s(p)) for alpha in {x,z}

T(gamma_star)=product_{links l intersecting gamma_star} X_l; for every closed dual curve available under OBC, T(gamma_star) is a product of enclosed Gauss operators and equals I on the physical sector
H_lat=-(1/a)*(g^2*sum_{x=0..2,y=0..3} product_{p in A(h(x,y))} tau_x(p) + g^2*sum_{x=0..3,y=0..2} product_{p in A(v(x,y))} tau_x(p) + g^(-2)*sum_{x=0..2,y=0..2} tau_z(p(x,y)))

experience_selection.reason: No historical candidate was supplied. An exact Z2-specific open-boundary Gauss-law reduction was derived because it preserves the requested physical sector and lowers the representation from the infeasible full link space to the complete 512-dimensional physical space.

field_encodings.degrees_of_freedom: One dual Pauli degree of freedom tau_p for every indexed plaquette p; this is exactly the G_v=+1 subspace of the complete Z2 link Hilbert space.
field_encodings.truncation: None. The local Z2 link representation is already finite, and Gauss-law elimination is exact.

lattice.geometry: Two-dimensional square lattice with vertices (x,y), x,y in {0,1,2,3}; horizontal links h(x,y) for x=0..2,y=0..3; vertical links v(x,y) for x=0..3,y=0..2; plaquettes p(x,y) for x,y=0..2.

lattice_symmetries.commutator_result: [H_lat,G(x,y)]=0 at every lattice vertex; after exact reduction G(x,y)=I

target_eigenvalues.glueball: zero-based level-1 energy in the physical sector

lattice_symmetries.commutator_result: Theta H_lat Theta^(-1)=H_lat because all Pauli coefficients and matrices appearing in H_lat are real
No nontrivial lattice translation maps the selected open-link and boundary-term sets to themselves
Contractible closed-curve operators commute with H_lat but reduce to I in the physical sector; OBC admits no noncontractible generators
